description: This file defines the CategoryDao interface which declares data access methods for Category entities within the sales manager application. It includes method signatures for retrieving categories based on various criteria such as store, URL, parent, lineage, name, code, depth, and language.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for Category entities, providing methods for querying categories based on store, URL, hierarchy, name, code, depth, lineage, and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Returns a list of categories matching the specified SEO URL within a given merchant store.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Fetches categories for a store filtered by a specific parent category.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories based on the lineage string within a store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Finds a category by name within a store, considering a specific language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Returns a category matching the provided code within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories associated with a store.

methods.name: listByStoreAndLanguage
methods.description: Lists categories for a store filtered by a language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories within a store at a specific depth level.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by a lineage string using merchant store code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Gets a category by SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories that have a specific parent category within a language context.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID and language.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with a list of category IDs within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store, list of codes, and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store, list of IDs, and language.
